input.standard: ASTM E741 (concentration decay, single zone); ASTM D6245 (occupant CO2 as tracer)
input.purpose: Measure the volume of air V_lab served by /habitat/lab/eclss/scrubber-1-v4 as V = Qe * tau: a short CO2 rise at the floor speed, then a decay at full speed, the two lab occupants as the source. Start only if co2-1-v4 reads 1600 ppm or less just before step 1 (1550 ppm measured at task opening).

steps.why: Rise at the floor speed (Qe about 0.3 m3/min). The previous run rose about 48 ppm/min, so 10 min gives about +480 ppm, well above sensor noise, and ends near 2050 ppm from a start of 1550, far under the 2600 limit. Hatch closed and held closed.
Decay at full speed (Qe = 1 m3/min), recorded at 1 min toward the equilibrium. First guess V 15 to 30 m3 gives tau 15 to 30 min, so 30 min covers one to two time constants. Hatch unchanged.

monitoring.reason: The two lab occupants breathe the air whose CO2 is raised by the test; the hab-b occupants are not exposed with the hatch closed.

abort.when: the device refuses a step's command
a monitored person out of band, monitoring lost, or one more person in the lab

expected.rise: From about 1550 ppm, at 30 percent speed and 2 occupants (0.76 L/min CO2), the lab CO2 rises about 40 to 50 ppm/min (previous run 48 ppm/min), i.e. about +400 to +500 ppm in 10 min, ending near 2000 to 2100 ppm, under the 2600 limit. A rise much slower than 25 ppm/min would mean a larger V or hatch exchange. A rise faster than 100 ppm/min would mean a smaller V or larger source, and the 2800 abort would stop it.
expected.decay: At full speed CO2 falls toward C_eq = baseline + G/Qe with tau = V/Qe; the previous rate suggests V below the 30 m3 default, about 15 to 30 m3, tau 15 to 30 min (plus about 3.3 min scrubber lag, ignored in the fit after the first 10 min). Fit C(t) = C_eq + (C0 - C_eq) exp(-t/tau); V_lab = Qe * tau, expected within 10 to 200 m3.
expected.refutation: A fitted C_eq far from G/Qe, non-exponential residuals, or hab-b CO2 moving in step with the lab (it moved only 900 to 960 ppm in 22 min in the previous run) would show the lab is not one closed well-mixed zone, and V would be biased. A start above 1600 ppm means the test is not started.

hypotheses: Lab air is one well-mixed zone.

Exchange through the closed hatch to hab-b is not measured; it is a hypothesis (station-topology: design inter-module ventilation 3 m3/min hatch closed), not assumed zero; hab-b CO2 is recorded to reveal it. The hatch is held closed during the whole test.
Occupants' number (2) and activity (awake, 0.38 L/min each) are constant; no one enters or leaves.
Effective flow at full speed Qe = 1 m3/min per datasheet and scales linearly with speed; lag 3.33 min is ignored in the fit after the first 10 min of each step.
Sensor co2-1-v4 is accurate and its noise is small against the expected swing (hundreds of ppm).
Start CO2 is read from co2-1-v4 before step 1 and must be 1600 ppm or less.

justifications.reason: Below the 3200 ppm ceiling; expected peak about 2050, margin for a rise twice the observed 48 ppm/min.
Below the 3200 ppm signed ceiling and the 3500 ppm elevated level; above the 2600 working limit.

justifications.reason: Rise sized to observed rate and CO2 headroom, not the time budget.
